## Strongly Covered Areas

These areas have both facade and raw DLL evidence unless noted otherwise.

### Core Handles And Modes

- Opaque native image handles.
- Mode-aware storage for `1`, `L`, `LA`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, `P`, `CMYK`, `I`,
  and `F`.
- Internal unpacked mode `1` storage with Pillow-style bit-packed external raw
  bytes.
- Palette metadata for `P`, including RGB/RGBA palette storage and alpha mode
  tracking.
- `CMYK` direct storage and broad operation coverage.
- Narrow but working `I` and `F` foundations for scalar storage and raw bytes;
  mode `I` additionally has native numeric `getextrema()` coverage for signed
  int32 samples.

Remaining gap:

- `I` and `F` are not full arithmetic/filter/file-format participants; `I`
  conversions beyond `L`, filters, and arithmetic remain separate mode slices.
- Public little-endian `I;16` is now a first-class bounded image mode for
  direct bytes and TIFF save/open with uncompressed, PackBits, TIFF LZW, and
  Adobe Deflate strips. Public big-endian `I;16B` is covered for direct bytes
  and uncompressed TIFF save/open, and compressed public `I;16B` saves
  normalize to little-endian `I;16` like Pillow. `I;16B` DPI/multipage
  behavior, `I;16N`, broad conversion, filters, and arithmetic remain open.
- Bounded `YCbCr` and `HSV` storage plus RGB bidirectional conversion are
  covered by `MODE-COLOR-001A` and `MODE-COLOR-001B`; `MODE-COLOR-001C` also
  completes Pillow's direct `YCbCr -> L/LA` targets, and `MODE-COLOR-001D`
  adds RGBA/RGBX/CMYK sources to HSV. `MODE-COLOR-001E` adds byte grayscale
  sources `1`/`L`/`LA`, and `MODE-COLOR-001F` adds explicit RGB/RGBA palette
  sources while ignoring palette alpha. `MODE-COLOR-001G` adds first-class LAB
  storage and signed-channel raw packing, `MODE-COLOR-001H` adds PA storage
  plus explicit RGB/RGBA palette ownership, `MODE-COLOR-001I` adds bounded
  P/PA conversion plus PA-to-RGBA per-pixel alpha semantics, and
  `MODE-COLOR-001J` adds PA-to-RGB/L/LA, `MODE-COLOR-001K` adds
  PA-to-CMYK/YCbCr/HSV, `MODE-COLOR-001L` adds P-to-LA/YCbCr, and
  `MODE-COLOR-001M` adds P/PA-to-I/F numeric luma, and `MODE-COLOR-001N` adds
  P/PA-to-mode-1 direct thresholding, `MODE-COLOR-001P` adds P/PA-to-RGBX, and
  `MODE-COLOR-001Q` adds RGBX-to-RGB/RGBA/L/LA, `MODE-COLOR-001R` adds
  RGBX-to-CMYK/YCbCr, `MODE-COLOR-001S` adds RGBX-to-I/F, and
  `MODE-COLOR-001T` adds RGBX-to-mode-1, and `MODE-COLOR-001U` adds
  RGB/RGBA-to-I/F, `MODE-COLOR-001V` adds 1/L/LA-to-I/F,
  `MODE-COLOR-001W` adds YCbCr-to-I/F through RGB composition,
  `MODE-COLOR-001X` adds CMYK-to-I/F through RGB composition, and
  `MODE-COLOR-001Y` adds HSV-to-I/F through RGB composition. ImageCms LAB
  conversion, remaining quantizing RGBX targets,
  implicit/default palette
  behavior, plugin-specific raw modes,
  numeric/default-palette HSV edges, broader color-mode conversions/operations,
  and file participation remain open.

Next probes:

- Pillow conversion, arithmetic, histogram, and filter behavior for `I`, `F`,
  and public `I;16` plus endian variants.
- Source-level behavior for long-tail modes before adding public facade names.

### Raw Bytes And Pixel Data

Covered:

- `frombytes` / `tobytes` raw decoder and encoder paths for common raw modes.
- Direct `1`, `L`, `LA`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, `CMYK`, `I`, and `F` raw storage flows.
- BGR/BGRA/ARGB/ABGR/RGBX/BGRX-style byte shuffles.
- Stride and orientation handling for raw import.
- `getpixel`, `putpixel`, `getdata`, `putdata`, `DataPointer`, and storage
  sharing.
- Bounded `Image.frombuffer` raw `L` buffer-view lifecycle through native
  refresh/detach ABI and facade source-buffer lifetime ownership.
- Bounded raw mapmode override aliases for requested `RGB` with rawmode `L`,
  `RGBA`, or `RGBX`; the `RGBX` child exposes public mode id `10` and bands
  `R/G/B/X`.
- Direct `Image.frombuffer` `RGB` copy semantics and direct `RGBA`
  stride/orientation readonly alias/detach behavior.
- Native ImageDraw mutator exports detach caller-owned readonly frombuffer
  views before writing, including the covered public `ImageDraw.rectangle`
  path and the shared native draw-entry wrapper.
- Native paste image, masked paste, and paste color exports detach
  caller-owned readonly frombuffer views before writing, including the covered
  public `Image.Paste(image)` and `Image.Paste(color)` paths.
- Native resize, resize-box, and reducing-gap exports refresh caller-owned
  readonly frombuffer views before sampling, and public `Image.Thumbnail`
  replaces the original handle with an owned resized image.
- Native `pillow_c_image_get_bytes` and `pillow_c_image_get_raw_bytes` refresh
  caller-owned readonly frombuffer views before byte extraction while keeping
  the source view attached.

Remaining gap:

- Remaining read or mutating routes still need explicit readonly
  refresh/detach probes before they can be claimed, and general `RGBX`
  operation/mode coverage beyond raw bytes, `fromarray`, `fromarrow`, Qt
  constructors, and full zero-copy external memory ownership are not
  implemented.
- Only raw decoder/encoder semantics are exposed through facade bytes APIs.

Next probes:

- Lower-level `readonly` edge cases on implemented read/mutating paths, only
  when a local Pillow oracle proves a concrete miss.
- `Image.fromarray` dtype/mode inference if NumPy support becomes a target.
- Whether AHK should expose shared-memory buffers directly or keep a narrow
  DLL-owned handle model for stability.

### Geometry, Resize, Transform

Covered:

- `crop`, `expand`, `resize`, `resize(box=...)`, `thumbnail`,
  `reducing_gap`, `reduce`.
- Resamplers: `NEAREST`, `BOX`, `BILINEAR`, `HAMMING`, `BICUBIC`, `LANCZOS`
  for resize.
- `contain`, `cover`, `fit`, `pad`.
- `transpose` methods matching Pillow constants.
- `transform` for `AFFINE`, `EXTENT`, `PERSPECTIVE`, `QUAD`, and `MESH`.
- `rotate` with `NEAREST`, `BILINEAR`, `BICUBIC`, expansion, center,
  translate, and fill color.
- `_into` variants for many allocation-reuse paths.
- `CMYK` geometry coverage.
- Premultiplied-alpha sampling for `LA`/`RGBA` filtered geometry.

Remaining gap:

- Transform/rotate support is intentionally limited to the listed resamplers.
- More exhaustive large-image, weird-box, and numeric edge tests would improve
  confidence.

Next probes:

- Edge behavior for negative and fractional boxes across all resamplers.
- Decompression-bomb and huge-image memory behavior, if this wrapper adopts
  Pillow's safety policy rather than leaving it to callers.

### ImageOps, ImageChops, ImageStat

Covered:

- `ImageOps`: invert, grayscale, mirror, flip, exif transpose basics,
  posterize, solarize, colorize, equalize, autocontrast, crop, expand, scale,
  contain, cover, fit, pad, deform.
- `ImageChops`: blend, composite, constant, duplicate, invert, difference,
  multiply, screen, soft/hard light, overlay, lighter, darker, add, subtract,
  modulo operations, logical mode `1` operations, offset.
- `ImageStat.Stat`: histogram-backed extrema, count, sum, sum2, mean, median,
  rms, variance, stddev.
- Masked histograms/statistics for mode `1`/`L` masks.

Remaining gap:

- Some operations cover selected modes rather than every Pillow-supported mode.
- EXIF transpose is based on currently parsed orientation behavior, not full
  EXIF lifecycle support.

Next probes:

- Per-mode failures for each ImageOps and ImageChops operation, especially
  palette, `I`, `F`, and alpha-bearing modes.
- Full EXIF orientation lifecycle once EXIF metadata write/read is in scope.

### Filters And Enhancements

Covered:

- `ImageFilter.Kernel` for 3x3 and 5x5.
- Built-in kernel filters: blur, contour, detail, edge enhance, emboss, find
  edges, sharpen, smooth.
- Rank, min, median, max, mode filters.
- Box blur, Gaussian blur, UnsharpMask.
- `Color3DLUT`.
- `ImageEnhance`: brightness, contrast, sharpness, color.
- Mode coverage includes `L`, `LA`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, and `CMYK` for many filters.

Remaining gap:

- Filter coverage for `I`, `F`, and long-tail modes remains incomplete.
- No SIMD or threading has been introduced yet.
- Performance benchmarks are not yet a first-class regression gate.

Next probes:

- Pillow C source behavior for `I` and `F` filters before exposing them.
- Baseline native timings for representative small, medium, and large images.

### Palette And Quantize

Covered:

- `putpalette`, `getpalette`, `apply_transparency`, `remap_palette`.
- Palette preservation across many operations.
- Quantize with reference palette.
- Exact unique-color quantization for simple `L`/`RGB` cases.

Remaining gap:

- General Pillow quantization algorithms are not complete.
- Missing or incomplete: median cut, max coverage, fast octree parity,
  k-means behavior, full dither behavior, libimagequant-style optional path,
  and broad RGBA/GIF quantization workflows.

Next probes:

- Pillow `Image.quantize` algorithm selection by mode and option.
- GIF save quantization behavior for RGBA/RGB images with more than 256
  colors.
- Dither matrix and palette stability for repeated saves.

### ImageDraw And ImageFont

Covered:

- Rectangle, rounded rectangle, bitmap, floodfill, ellipse, arc, chord,
  pieslice, line, curve joints, point, polygon, regular polygon.
- Default-font text draw, text length, text bbox, multiline text, multiline
  bbox.
- Default font handle lifecycle and metadata.
- Bounded stroke support for current default-font paths.
- Printable ASCII default-font glyph coverage.

Remaining gap:

- No full FreeType loading.
- No general Unicode shaping/glyph coverage.
- Missing advanced text layout: direction, language, OpenType features,
  variation axes/names, embedded color glyphs, and full `justify` semantics.
- Facade currently rejects non-`Pillow.ImageFont` fonts in text paths.

Next probes:

- Dependency choice for FreeType on Windows, including binary distribution.
- Whether text shaping should stay out of scope until the DLL has a stable
  font ABI and packaging story.

## File Format Coverage

Current native file format surface:

- BMP open/save.
- Netpbm PBM/PGM/PPM open/save, including high-bit-depth grayscale PGM as `I`.
- QOI RGB/RGBA open/save.
- TGA open/save, including RLE and 24-bit color-mapped `P`.
- XBM mode `1` open/save, including hotspot metadata.
- ICO open and PNG/BMP-backed save, including default and custom `sizes`.
- PNG open/save for `L`, `LA`, `P`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, with selected options.
- JPEG open/save for `L` and `RGB`, with quality and DPI/JFIF density paths.
- TIFF open/save for `L`, `RGB`, `RGBA`, plus basic frame open/count.
- GIF open/save for selected `P`, exact `L`/`RGB`, later-frame read-side local
  rectangle composition, and simple same-palette animation paths.

Important format gaps:

- Local Pillow reports `48` open/save/save_all format identifiers; this project covers the
  practical core subset, not the long tail.
- Missing major families include WebP, AVIF, JPEG2000, PDF, PSD, DDS, CUR,
  ICNS, PCX, SGI, SUN, EPS, MPO, FLI, DCX, XPM, and others.
- Even for covered formats, plugin options and metadata are partial.

Format risk rule:

- Treat every new format option as a small compatibility feature, not as a
  generic string option. Pillow plugin semantics are often format-specific and
  need local probes or source confirmation.

### PNG Gaps

Covered:

- Core decode/encode for `L`, `LA`, `P`, `RGB`, `RGBA`.
- Stored `compress_level=0`.
- DPI `pHYs` write/read.
- Save-side `interlace`, `gamma`, and `optimize=True` bounded option
  behavior.
- Palette-mode and `LA` semantics that WIC does not preserve reliably.

Remaining:

- Tuned native compression for levels `1..9`.
- Remaining metadata/option tails: chromaticity, explicit `gAMA` writing, and
  metadata or transparency combinations.
- Broader mode and edge-case parity.

Next probes:

- Continue with `FMT-PNG-001S` for a bounded `pnginfo` plus ICC plus EXIF
  save before returning to JPEG codec-strategy work.

### JPEG Gaps

Covered:

- `L` and `RGB` lossy encode/decode.
- Quality option.
- DPI/JFIF density write/read.
- Basic EXIF orientation probing for transpose workflows.
- Bounded JPEG save/open metadata for comment, EXIF bytes, single-segment ICC,
  and `FMT-JPEG-001A` multi-segment ICC through marker patching and native
  metadata exports.
- Bounded RGB JPEG save-side subsampling factors for Pillow's `0/1/2` and
  `4:4:4`/`4:2:2`/`4:2:0` aliases through WIC.
- Bounded optimized-Huffman and progressive SOF2 JPEG output for `L` and `RGB`,
  including RGB metadata plus native optimize/progressive routing.
- Bounded CMYK JPEG open for a Pillow-generated four-component SOF0 fixture
  with Adobe APP14 transform `0`.
- Bounded baseline CMYK JPEG save at `quality=95` through the native JPEG
  encoder.
- Bounded baseline CMYK JPEG metadata save with comment, ICC, and EXIF through
  the existing native metadata export.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2T` tail: bounded raw JPEG `extra` marker streams for
  metadata-free `L`, `RGB`, and `CMYK` saves, including DPI, optimize,
  progressive, and bounded RGB subsampling. The DLL inserts the bytes after
  JFIF/Adobe headers and before DQT; `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_extra_options`
  owns the native route and the facade holds the source Buffer for the call.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2T-META`, `FMT-JPEG-002B2T-QTABLES`,
  `FMT-JPEG-002B2T-RESTART-EXTRA`, `FMT-JPEG-002B2T-KEEP-RGB-EXTRA`, and
  `FMT-JPEG-002B2T-KEEP-RGB-QTABLES-EXTRA`: bounded explicit metadata,
  one/two custom qtables, block/row restart markers, raw `extra`, no-qtables
  keep-rgb, and RGB qtables-plus-keep-rgb composition now use DLL-owned
  routes, with facade Buffer lifetime preserved. Keep-rgb combined with
  extra plus restart markers remains an explicit boundary.

Remaining:

- qtables with three or four tables and broader advanced-option precedence.
- Keep-rgb combined with `extra` plus restart markers, three/four-table
  qtables, malformed marker streams, other modes, and exact whole-file/entropy
  parity.
- CMYK metadata-plus-advanced save options and YCCK handling.
- More exact Pillow parity around malformed EXIF, conflicting/malformed ICC
  segment sets, ICC color-management behavior, and broad marker preservation.

Next probes:

- YCCK decode/save behavior and remaining qtables beyond mode `L`/`RGB`.
- WIC capability boundary for progressive SOF2 versus native marker patching
  or an alternate codec.
- Pillow `JpegImagePlugin` source for the remaining `extra` combinations,
  metadata plus `keep_rgb`, and YCCK behavior.

### TIFF Gaps

Covered:

- WIC-backed `L`, `RGB`, `RGBA` open/save.
- Basic multiframe open/count/seek.

Remaining:

- Multipage save.
- Compression options.
- Tag read/write parity.
- Palette, bilevel, high-bit, `I`, `F`, and many TIFF plugin paths.
- BigTIFF and advanced metadata are not covered.

Next probes:

- WIC support for compression and tags versus a native TIFF writer.
- Pillow `TiffImagePlugin` behavior for `save_all`, `append_images`, `tiffinfo`,
  `compression`, and high-bit modes.

### GIF Gaps

Covered:

- Frame `0` as `P` with palette.
- Later simple frames through current WIC/native paths.
- Duration, loop, background, disposal metadata parsing.
- Graphic Control Extension transparency index parsing into
  `info["transparency"]`.
- Later-frame GIF open/seek composes tested local rectangles into a logical
  RGB canvas instead of exposing the raw local frame size.
- Disposal `1`, `2`, and `3` read-side local-rectangle behavior is covered for
  the current hand-crafted fixtures.
- Transparent local-rectangle read-side composition is covered for the current
  hand-crafted disposal `1` and `2` fixtures.
- `ImageSequence.Iterator` live seek-state behavior is covered for a complex
  transparent local-rectangle fixture: immediate yielded frames match direct
  seek, and retained yielded references report the final frame like Pillow.
- Single-frame `P` save and exact-color `L`/`RGB` quantization.
- Single-frame exact-color `RGBA` GIF save for <=256 effective palette entries,
  including `alpha == 0` transparency and partial-alpha-as-opaque behavior.
- Single-frame `RGB` and `RGBA` GIF save above 256 effective colors for the
  bounded default-save fixtures, using deterministic weighted median-cut style
  fallbacks and preserving the verified `alpha == 0` transparency rule for
  RGBA.
- Single-frame GIF save `dither` options are pinned for the bounded RGB/RGBA
  >256 fixtures: Pillow 11.3.0 ignores the save option, and raw/facade tests
  assert deterministic/default-identical output.
- Single-frame P-mode GIF save with integer `Transparency`/`transparency`
  index.
- Simple same-size same-palette animation save.
- Save-side frame differencing is covered for the selected 3x3 P-mode
  animation fixture: frame 1 is written as a local `(1, 1, 1, 1)` rectangle,
  identical frames merge duration, and the selected default transparency-index
  optimization round-trips through raw DLL and facade tests.
- Save-side per-frame local palette behavior is covered for the selected
  P-mode animation fixture where frame 1 has a different RGB palette from
  frame 0. The writer compares palette RGB values for differencing and writes
  frame 1's own local color table.
- Explicit animation `include_color_table` and `optimize` save options are
  covered for the bounded P-mode fixtures: `include_color_table=True` forces a
  frame-0 local color table, `include_color_table=False` does not suppress
  later bbox-frame local tables, and `optimize=False` writes 4-entry color
  tables with `LzwMin=8` while disabling unchanged-pixel transparency
  substitution when no caller transparency is supplied.
- Caller-provided animation `background` is covered for the bounded
  logical-screen background-byte slice on the `3x1` per-frame palette fixture.

Remaining:

- Broader animation composition semantics.
- Save-side frame differencing and frame-rectangle optimization beyond the
  current `FMT-GIF-002E` fixture.
- Remaining bounded post-`disposal=2` edge cases after the covered
  transparency-aware re-diff fixture.
- Animation RGB/RGBA quantization before GIF differencing and behavior above
  256 colors outside the current bounded single-frame fixtures.
- Broader caller-provided `background` interactions, broader disposal
  combinations, and complex per-frame palettes.

Next probes:

- Move to `FMT-PNG-001` for the next high-value format slice.
- Pillow `GifImagePlugin` source remains useful only if a later GIF packet is
  explicitly selected, especially for uncovered disposal/background matrices.

### ICO/CUR Gaps

Covered:

- ICO open through WIC, returning largest frame as `RGBA`.
- PNG-backed ICO save with Pillow default sizes.
- Custom `sizes` option with sorting, de-duplication, skipping, and
  thumbnail-style LANCZOS containment.
- `sizes=[]` empty ICO directory behavior.
- BMP-backed ICO save via exact lowercase `bitmap_format="bmp"` for Pillow's
  `1`, `L`, `P`, `RGB`, and `RGBA` save modes.
- Uppercase or non-`bmp` bitmap format strings fall back to PNG-backed output
  like Pillow.
- `append_images` exact source-size entries.
- Public ICO `size` setter plus `load()` selected-frame behavior.
- Public ICO `ico.sizes()` and `ico.getimage(size)` with missing-size fallback
  to the largest frame.

Remaining:

- `append_images` non-exact thumbnail source selection and duplicate-size
  bit-depth selection.
- CUR cursor format and hotspot semantics.

Next probes:

- Pillow `IcoImagePlugin` frame selection and `append_images` behavior.
- CUR header/hotspot parsing and save option naming.

Current BigTIFF child override: the older aggregate `FMT-TIFF-003` row below
predates `FMT-TIFF-003X` through `FMT-TIFF-003AF`. Those child cards are
covered for uncompressed, compressed, two-frame chunky tiled open,
Orientation 2–8, chunky RGBX storage, and uncompressed planar-separate
`L`/`RGB`/`RGBA`, plus compressed planar-separate
`L`/`RGB`/`RGBA`/`RGBX`/`LA` and tiled `I;16`/`I`/`F`/`CMYK`; the selected
boundary is `FMT-TIFF-003AG` Pillow-valid little-endian BigTIFF IFD0
`ICCProfile`/XMP metadata attachment.

## Open Gap Detail Cards

These cards expand the ledger rows into execution-ready work packets. Keep
them current enough that a future session can choose one card, open only the
named files, and begin with a bounded Pillow probe instead of re-auditing the
repository.

### FMT-GIF-002D: Iterator State Parity

Status: covered.

Current covered baseline:

- `FMT-GIF-002A` proves local image rectangles compose into a logical RGB
  canvas for a disposal-`1` preservation fixture.
- `FMT-GIF-002B` proves disposal `2` and `3` local-rectangle restoration.
- `FMT-GIF-002C` proves transparent local-rectangle composition and RGB-frame
  transparency-info removal.
- Existing probes found `ImageSequence.Iterator` matched repeated `seek` for
  the current hand-crafted fixtures.
- The `FMT-GIF-002D` probe confirmed retained iterator frames remain live
  references to the source image and mutate to the final frame after
  iteration.

Resolved behavior:

- Pillow 11.3.0 `PIL.ImageSequence.Iterator.__next__` and `__getitem__` seek
  the wrapped image and return `self.im`.
- Retained yielded frames are not safe independent snapshots. Callers need
  `copy()`/`ImageSequence.all_frames` when they want stable frame objects.
- For the selected complex GIF fixture, immediate iterator pixels, mode, and
  duration match direct `seek`; retained references report the final frame
  after iteration.
- Mutation side effects between iterator steps are still deferred because the
  selected source and black-box probes only prove live seek-state identity, not
  arbitrary user mutation behavior.

Start in code/tests:

- `ahk/pillow.ahk`: `Pillow.ImageSequence.Iterator`, `Image.Seek`,
  `ApplyFrameMetadata`.
- `ahk/pillow.test.ahk`: GIF open/sequence block.
- Add raw DLL coverage in `ahk/pillow_c.test.ahk` only if the iterator probe
  exposes a native frame-composition gap.

Oracle/source work:

- Completed with `F:\Python\Python310\python.exe` and Pillow `11.3.0`.
- Installed `PIL/ImageSequence.py` was inspected for `Iterator.__next__` and
  `Iterator.__getitem__`.

Exit criteria:

- A facade test covers the selected iterator-only edge and records that AHK
  returns live seek-state views, not retained frame copies.
- Direct `Seek` and iterator behavior are both asserted when Pillow says they
  should match.
- This document records any iterator semantics deliberately deferred.

### FMT-GIF-002E: Animation Save Differencing

Status: covered for the selected 3x3 P-mode fixture.

Current covered baseline:

- The project can save simple same-size same-palette GIF animations.
- Read-side local-rectangle composition now handles several Pillow-like
  disposal and transparency fixtures.
- Raw and facade tests cover optimized local rectangles for a small P-mode
  animation where only the center pixel changes.
- The native writer now emits the expected frame descriptors, metadata, local
  color table, and LZW stream for the selected fixture. The saved file reopens
  through the native GIF compositor instead of falling back to WIC.

Resolved behavior for the current fixture:

- Pillow's current frame differencing rules were checked in
  `GifImagePlugin._write_multiple_frames`, `_write_frame_data`,
  `_write_local_header`, and `_getbbox`.
- Identical frames are dropped and their duration is merged into the previous
  output frame.
- A one-pixel center change in a 3x3 P-mode same-palette animation writes a
  second local rectangle `(1, 1, 1, 1)`.
- With default optimize behavior, Pillow allocates transparency index `2` for
  this fixture and writes it in the second frame's Graphic Control Extension.
- If the previous output frame disposal is `2`, the next frame tends toward a
  full-frame write for the currently scoped implementation.
- The native LZW encoder must increase code size only after
  `next_code > (1 << code_size)` for this fixture. The earlier equality
  threshold produced a stream that confused the native reader and caused a WIC
  fallback to a local-frame image.

Still unknown or deferred:

- Full option precedence for `background`, mixed disposal lists, and their
  interaction with `include_color_table`, `optimize=False`, and caller
  transparency.
- RGB/RGBA quantization before GIF differencing; keep that in `FMT-GIF-003`.
- Per-frame palette changes and palette reduction; keep that in `FMT-GIF-004`
  unless a small test exposes a required parser/writer fix.

Start in code/tests:

- `src/pillow_c.cpp`: `save_gif_animation_image`.
- `ahk/pillow.ahk`: `Save`, `SaveGifAnimation`, GIF option normalization.
- `ahk/pillow_c.test.ahk` and `ahk/pillow.test.ahk`: animation save blocks.

  while public `Image.Quantize` remains a separate algorithm surface.

  same-size RGBA frames with source `alpha == 0` are quantized to temporary
  native P images with transparency index `0` reserved when needed, preserving

  metadata.
- `FMT-GIF-003B6` adds bounded mixed RGB/RGBA animation quantization:
  same-size RGB/RGBA frames are independently quantized to temporary native P
  images before the existing GIF writer, preserving Pillow-compatible
  composited reopened RGBA pixels plus duration and loop metadata on the
  selected mixed fixture.
- `FMT-GIF-003B7` adds one bounded lossy mixed RGB/RGBA animation fallback:
  an `18x18` RGB stress frame plus an `18x18` RGBA stress frame with more than

- `FMT-GIF-003B8` adds bounded exact-color L-mode animation quantization:

- `FMT-GIF-003B9` adds bounded exact-color LA-mode animation quantization:

- `FMT-GIF-003B10` adds explicit caller transparency with the bounded exact
  RGBA animation fixture: `transparency=2` is accepted, frame 2 keeps the
  caller transparency GCE while the source alpha-0 pixel reopens opaque like

Pillow 11.3.0 oracle results already resolved for `FMT-GIF-003A`:

  transparent RGB values collapse to the first transparent palette entry.

Status: partial (bounded native algorithm slice covered; broader parity open).

Strategy note: `FMT-PNG-001AA` was the last useful narrow custom-chunk
combination before `FMT-PNG-004A` introduced the generalized native PNG
metadata route. Do not keep adding one export, facade branch, or work branch
per metadata Cartesian product when the generalized route can express the
behavior. Future PNG work should extend
`pillow_c_image_save_png_metadata_options`, batch related same-route cases in
one raw/facade test where semantics are already known, and reserve new narrow
branches for genuinely new native capability, ABI shape, or Pillow semantic
boundary.
`FMT-PNG-004X` adds one real custom-chunk boundary by accepting Pillow-style
private pre-`IDAT` chunk types such as `b"vpAg"` through existing PNG chunk
routes. `FMT-PNG-004Y` adds the matching private `after_idat=True` placement
through the generalized metadata route. `FMT-PNG-004Z` adds the zero-length
payload boundary for the same private chunk family. `FMT-PNG-004AA` adds one
new batch ABI for multiple private chunks, preserving caller order before and
after `IDAT`. Do not add further PNG one-combination branches unless a local
Pillow 11.3.0 probe demonstrates a real missing public/standard chunk rule,
mixed metadata boundary, or reusable ABI shape; otherwise move effort to GIF
correctness probes or JPEG codec strategy.

Current covered baseline:

- Native PNG open/save covers `L`, `LA`, `P`, `RGB`, and `RGBA`.
- `compress_level=0`, bounded `compress_level=1`, DPI `pHYs`, `interlace`
  no-op, `gamma` no-op, `optimize=True` zlib header behavior, palette mode,
  and `LA` behavior have focused coverage.
- `FMT-PNG-001A` covers `gAMA` open metadata: native PNG open scans the chunk
  and the facade exposes Pillow-compatible `Info["gamma"]`.
- `FMT-PNG-001AB` covers dynamic-Huffman compressed text open metadata:
  native PNG open inflates dynamic-Huffman `zTXt` and compressed `iTXt`
  payloads through the existing PNG text metadata ABI, and WIC sees a
  decode-only PNG copy with compressed text chunks removed to avoid a local
  WIC hang.
- `FMT-PNG-001AC` covers NUL-free bytes-valued
  `PngInfo.add_text("Latin", bytes([99,97,102,233]))`: native PNG save writes
  raw Latin-1 `tEXt` bytes, `zip=True` writes compressed `zTXt`, and native
  reopen converts `tEXt`/`zTXt` Latin-1 metadata to UTF-8 before the facade
  exposes final `Info` / `Text` values.
- `FMT-PNG-001AD` covers embedded-NUL bytes-valued
  `PngInfo.add_text("Nulls", bytes([97,0,98]))`: native PNG save routes
  explicit value byte sizes through
  `pillow_c_image_save_png_text_entries_value_sizes_options`, writes exact
  `tEXt` or compressed `zTXt` payload bytes, and the facade reopens
  `Info["Nulls"]` / `Text["Nulls"]` as `a`, `Chr(0)`, `b`.
- `FMT-PNG-001U` covers explicit `cHRM` save/open metadata through
  bytes-valued `PngInfo.add(...)`: native PNG save writes the bounded
  thirty-two-byte payload before `IDAT`, native PNG open scans it, and the
  facade exposes Pillow-compatible `Info["chromaticity"]`.
- `FMT-PNG-001V` covers one custom chunk plus ordinary text combination:
  `PngInfo.add(b"cHRM", ...)` plus `PngInfo.add_text("Author", "Ada")`
  writes chunk order `IHDR`, `cHRM`, `tEXt`, `IDAT`, `IEND`, native open
  preserves RGB bytes plus chromaticity and text metadata, and the facade
  exposes both `Info["chromaticity"]` and `Info["Author"]`/`Text["Author"]`
  without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-PNG-001W` covers one custom chunk plus ICC combination:
  `PngInfo.add(b"cHRM", ...)` plus `icc_profile=bytes([1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8])`
  writes chunk order `IHDR`, `iCCP`, `cHRM`, `IDAT`, `IEND`, native open
  preserves RGB bytes plus chromaticity and decompressed ICC metadata, and the
  facade exposes both `Info["chromaticity"]` and `Info["icc_profile"]` without
  AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-PNG-001X` covers one custom chunk plus EXIF combination:
  `PngInfo.add(b"cHRM", ...)` plus EXIF orientation bytes writes chunk order
  `IHDR`, `cHRM`, `eXIf`, `IDAT`, `IEND`, native open preserves RGB bytes plus
  chromaticity and Pillow-style EXIF metadata, and the facade exposes both
  `Info["chromaticity"]` and `Info["exif"]` without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-PNG-001Y`, `FMT-PNG-001Z`, and `FMT-PNG-001AA` cover custom chunk plus RGB
  transparency combinations: `PngInfo.add(b"cHRM", ...)` plus either
  RGB tuple transparency, exactly three RGB transparency bytes, or ordinary
  text plus RGB tuple transparency writes Pillow-compatible chunk order,
  native open preserves RGB bytes plus chromaticity and RGB transparency
  metadata, and native `RGB -> RGBA` conversion makes matching RGB pixels
  transparent.
- `FMT-PNG-004E` covers ordinary `PngInfo.add_text("Author", "Ada")` plus RGB
  tuple transparency through the generalized native metadata route: native PNG
  save writes `IHDR`, `tEXt`, `tRNS`, `IDAT`, `IEND`, native open preserves RGB
  bytes plus text and RGB transparency metadata, and native `RGB -> RGBA`
  conversion makes matching RGB pixels transparent.
- `FMT-PNG-004F` covers compressed `PngInfo.add_text("Note",

  native PNG save writes chunk order `IHDR`, `PLTE`, `tRNS`, `IDAT`, `IEND`
  with payload `[255,128,0,64]`, native open preserves P indexes, the facade
  exposes `Info["transparency"]` as a `Buffer`, and native `P -> RGBA`
  conversion uses palette alpha values `[255,128,0,64]`.
- `FMT-PNG-002H` covers one RGB bytes-valued `transparency` save fixture:
  native PNG save accepts exactly three RGB transparency bytes, writes
  truecolor `tRNS` payload `[0,10,0,20,0,30]`, native open preserves RGB
  bytes, the facade exposes `Info["transparency"] == [10, 20, 30]`, and
  native `RGB -> RGBA` conversion makes matching RGB pixels transparent.

Unknown behavior to pin down:

- remaining metadata combinations, custom chunk combinations beyond the
  standalone `gAMA`/`cHRM` fixtures and the covered `cHRM` plus ordinary text,
  ICC, EXIF, and RGB transparency fixtures,
  ICC/EXIF preservation and option combinations beyond the covered ICC save,
  EXIF save, `pnginfo` plus ICC fixture, `pnginfo` plus EXIF fixture,
  ICC plus EXIF fixture, and custom `cHRM` plus ICC/EXIF fixtures, plus
  broader partial alpha-table transparency behavior.
- Remaining option precedence among `compress_level`, `optimize`, `bits`,
  `dictionary`, metadata, transparency, and `pnginfo`, plus exact compressed
  byte/size parity beyond the bounded `compress_level=1` zlib header fixture.
- Whether native zlib work is enough or whether some metadata can be patched
  around the existing writer.

Start in code/tests:

- `src/pillow_c.cpp`: PNG chunk writer/reader and save-options export.
- `ahk/pillow.ahk`: save option parsing and metadata propagation.
- PNG metadata and save-option tests in both raw and facade suites.

Exit criteria:

- Each new option behavior or ABI boundary gets an oracle fixture and a ledger
  row update. Same-route metadata combinations should be batched in one
  raw/facade test instead of split into `FMT-PNG-001AA`-style branches. Do not
  claim "PNG metadata" covered until individual chunk types are tested.

Status: partial.

Current covered baseline:

- `L` and `RGB` JPEG open/save work through current native/WIC paths.
- Quality and DPI/JFIF density are covered.
- Basic EXIF orientation is used for transpose workflows.
- `FMT-JPEG-001` covers bounded save/open metadata for `comment`,
  `icc_profile`, and `exif`: native save writes APP1 EXIF, single-segment APP2
  ICC, and COM markers after APP0/JFIF, native open stores the byte metadata,
  and the facade exposes reopened `Info` buffers.
- `FMT-JPEG-002A` covers bounded `subsampling=0/1/2` and Pillow preset
  aliases:
  native save writes Pillow-compatible SOF0 sampling factors through WIC's
  `JpegYCrCbSubsampling` option, and the facade routes integer/string options
  without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002C` covers bounded JPEG `quality` preset strings:
  the facade packs Pillow 11.3.0 preset quantization tables, applies preset
  subsampling, overrides explicit `qtables`/`subsampling` like Pillow, and
  routes through the existing native qtables ABI with `quality == -1`.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B1` covers the historical progressive/optimize option boundary:
  native `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_encode_options` accepts false/default
  `progressive` and `optimize` values. Later native codec slices now cover
  optimized-Huffman output plus bounded mode `L` and `RGB` progressive output.
  The facade recognizes `progressive`, `progression`, and `optimize` aliases
  and routes supported non-metadata true-option saves to the DLL while
  unsupported true surfaces still fail explicitly.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2A` covers the first real optimized-Huffman encoder slice:
  mode `L` `quality=75,optimize=True` writes a DLL-owned baseline SOF0 JPEG
  with one SOS scan and compact optimized DHT tables. The facade now routes
  non-metadata `optimize=True` to the DLL, while unsupported optimized JPEG
  surfaces still fail natively.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2B` extends optimized-Huffman encoding to bounded mode `RGB`
  with `quality=75,optimize=True,subsampling=0`: native save writes baseline
  SOF0, 4:4:4 component sampling, one SOS scan, separate luma/chroma
  quantization tables, four compact optimized DHT tables, and interleaved
  Y/Cb/Cr entropy without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2C` generalizes optimized-Huffman RGB encoding to Pillow's
  default 4:2:0 sampling plus explicit `subsampling=1` / 4:2:2 and
  `subsampling=2` / 4:2:0 on a bounded `16x16` RGB fixture. The facade's
  ordinary `optimize=True` RGB save now routes to the DLL without needing an
  AHK pixel loop.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2D` adds real mode `L` progressive JPEG output: native
  `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_encode_options` accepts
  `mode=L,quality=75,progressive=1,subsampling=-1`, writes SOF2 with
  Pillow-compatible six-scan grayscale headers, and reopens as mode `L`. The
  facade routes both `progressive=True` and the legacy `progression=True` alias
  without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2E` adds real mode `RGB` progressive JPEG output: native
  `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_encode_options` accepts
  `mode=RGB,quality=75,progressive=1,subsampling=-1/0/1/2`, writes SOF2 with
  Pillow-compatible ten-scan RGB headers and expected default/4:4:4/4:2:2/4:2:0
  sampling, and reopens as mode `RGB`. The facade routes `progressive=True`,
  `progression=True`, one covered `optimize=True` composition, and integer or
  string `subsampling` values without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2F` adds metadata plus native encoder composition for bounded
  RGB saves: `comment`, `icc_profile`, and `exif` combine with
  `optimize=True` baseline output or `progressive=True,optimize=True` SOF2
  output through `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_metadata_encode_options`, preserving
  APP1/APP2/COM marker order after APP0/JFIF and reopened metadata without AHK
  pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2G` adds bounded RGB `keep_rgb=True` output:
  `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_encode_keep_rgb_options` writes APP14 Adobe
  transform `0`, omits JFIF, uses SOF/SOS component IDs `R/G/B`, keeps all
  components at `1x1` sampling with qtable `0`, supports baseline optimized
  DHTs and progressive SOF2 output, and the facade routes non-metadata
  `keep_rgb=True` without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2H` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus optimized output:
  `pillow_c_image_save_jpeg_qtables_encode_options` accepts one or two
  natural-order 64-entry integer qtables, quality-scales them, writes custom
  DQT payloads in zigzag order, preserves default/0/1/2 RGB subsampling, emits
  optimized DHTs, and the facade routes non-metadata, non-keep-rgb `qtables`
  saves without AHK pixel loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2I` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus progressive output:
  the same qtables export now accepts `progressive=True` without requiring
  `optimize=True`, writes SOF2 with Pillow-compatible ten-scan RGB progressive
  SOS headers, preserves default/0/1/2 RGB subsampling, and reopens as mode
  `RGB`.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2J` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus metadata for the
  optimized and progressive qtables routes: native save writes APP1 EXIF,
  APP2 ICC, and COM after APP0/JFIF and before the qtables DQT payloads, then
  reopens with comment, ICC, and EXIF orientation metadata.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2K` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus keep-rgb output:
  native save writes APP14/no-JFIF RGB-component JPEGs, custom DQT table
  selectors, one baseline/optimized SOS or 14 progressive keep-rgb scans, and
  rejects unsupported keep-rgb subsampling values.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2L` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus default-Huffman
  output: native save accepts the same one or two custom qtables without
  requiring `optimize=True` or `progressive=True`, writes default 4:2:0 SOF0,
  standard luma/chroma DHT payloads `[29,179,29,179]`, one SOS, and composes
  the same baseline route with comment, ICC, and EXIF metadata before the DQT
  payloads.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2M` adds bounded mode `L` custom qtables output through the
  same qtables exports: native save accepts one or two custom qtables while
  writing only quality-scaled DQT table `0`, writes SOF0 with standard

- `FMT-JPEG-002B2N` adds bounded RGB metadata plus `keep_rgb=True` output:
  native save writes APP14/no-JFIF RGB-component JPEGs through the keep-rgb
  encoder, then inserts APP1 EXIF, APP2 ICC, and COM after APP14 and before

- `FMT-JPEG-002B2O` adds bounded CMYK custom qtables output through the same
  qtables export: native save accepts one or two custom qtables, quality-scales

  second table selected by `M/Y/K`, standard luminance DHTs `[29,179]`, one

- `FMT-JPEG-002B2P` adds bounded RGB custom qtables plus `keep_rgb=True` plus
  explicit metadata output through the existing qtables metadata keep-rgb

- `FMT-JPEG-002B2Q` adds bounded RGB `keep_rgb=True` plus DPI/JFIF output:
  native save writes APP0/JFIF before APP14 transform `0`, keeps RGB
  component IDs and `1x1` sampling, reopens as mode `RGB`, and exposes
  Pillow-style DPI/JFIF metadata. The facade routes the public `{keep_rgb:true,

- `FMT-JPEG-002B2R` adds bounded opened RGB JPEG `qtables="keep"` plus
  `keep_rgb=True` facade routing: the existing native qtables keep-rgb export
  preserves opened DQT tables and opened COM/comment metadata when called with
  default subsampling, while the facade now avoids copying the opened sampled
  YCbCr subsampling into this RGB keep-rgb save shape.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2S` adds bounded baseline mode `L`
  `restart_marker_blocks=1`: the native standard-Huffman encoder writes DRI,
  flushes entropy at MCU intervals, emits cyclic RST markers, resets the DC
  predictor, and reopens through the DLL. The facade routes the public option
  without an AHK pixel loop; other restart surfaces remain explicit gaps.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2T` extends the same existing restart export to bounded
  baseline mode `RGB` with default `4:2:0` sampling. Native interleaved entropy
  flushes at MCU intervals, writes cyclic RST markers, resets all Y/Cb/Cr DC
  predictors, and keeps standard luma/chroma DHTs; the facade routes this RGB
  shape without an AHK pixel loop.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2U` adds bounded baseline `restart_marker_rows=1` for mode `L`
  and default `4:2:0` mode `RGB`. The additive rows export derives MCU columns
  from native image geometry, converts rows to the 16-bit DRI block interval,
  and reuses the existing restart entropy encoders. The facade routes both
  option aliases and rejects simultaneous row/block options explicitly.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2V` composes explicit comment/ICC/EXIF/XMP with bounded
  baseline L/RGB block or row restart intervals. A shared native restart core
  prevents implicit source comment insertion on the explicit-metadata route,
  while the additive ABI validates and inserts metadata once after encoding;
  the facade routes the public option combinations without AHK file rewriting.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2W` composes optimized-Huffman output with bounded L restart
  blocks and default-4:2:0 RGB restart rows plus optional explicit metadata.
  Restart-aware frequency collection resets DC predictors at the same block/MCU
  boundaries as entropy encoding; RGB luma converts the MCU interval to a
  Y-block interval while Cb/Cr use the MCU interval directly. Native L matches
  Pillow DHT lengths `[20,31]`; native RGB deterministically writes
  `[22,44,22,36]` rather than injecting Pillow/libjpeg's unused chroma DC
  category `0` solely to copy `[22,44,23,36]`. Both routes preserve DRI/RST
  structure, decode compatibility, and explicit metadata without AHK loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2X` composes native progressive scans with bounded L restart
  blocks and default-4:2:0 RGB restart rows plus optional explicit metadata.
  L keeps DRI `3` across six scans with one `RST0` per scan. RGB derives
  interleaved/chroma and luma-only row widths separately, emits DRI sequence
  `[3,6,3,6,3,6]` across ten scans, and resets each scan's restart cycle to
  `RST0`. Progressive DC frequency collection and all progressive entropy scan
  writers honor restart boundaries; the facade routes the byte-equivalent
  optimize composition and metadata without AHK loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2Y` composes custom qtables with restart markers for bounded
  mode `L`, optimized RGB 4:4:4, and progressive RGB 4:2:2 output. The shared
  qtables encoder derives row intervals from actual sampling geometry, resets
  optimized DC frequency collection at restart boundaries, and writes DRI/RST
  through baseline or progressive entropy paths. The additive metadata-capable
  ABI and facade route preserve custom DQT, SOF sampling, explicit metadata,
  and reopened output without AHK pixel or JPEG rewrite loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2Z` composes bounded RGB keep-rgb output with restart markers
  for baseline, optimized metadata, and custom-qtables progressive metadata
  saves. One optional-qtables ABI owns APP14/RGB-component encode, metadata,
  DRI, and RST output. It also fixes AC refinement correction-bit partitioning
  at 16-zero ZRL boundaries, eliminating bad-Huffman warnings on the larger
  fourteen-scan fixture without AHK pixel or JPEG rewrite loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2AA` extends the plain baseline restart ABI to default-1x1
  CMYK. Block and row intervals are normalized natively, DRI precedes SOS,
  entropy boundaries reset C/M/Y/K DC predictors, and the facade routes the
  bounded surface without AHK pixel or JPEG rewrite loops. Advanced CMYK
  restart composition remains explicit and separate.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2AB` extends that CMYK route to optimized Huffman coding with
  optional explicit metadata. Restart-aware frequency collection and entropy
  encoding reset the same four predictors; the existing metadata encode ABI
  and facade route the bounded surface without AHK pixel or file loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2AC` extends the progressive metadata restart ABI to
  default-1x1 CMYK. One stable DRI applies to all 18 scans; each scan starts its
  restart sequence at `RST0`, and interleaved DC-first boundaries reset all
  four predictors. The facade routes optional metadata without AHK loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-002B2AD` composes custom qtables with default-1x1 CMYK baseline,
  optimized, and progressive restart output. The shared qtables ABI preserves
  two DQT tables, metadata, scan-local DRI/RST structure, and exact covered
  CMYK reopen bytes without AHK pixel or file loops.
- `FMT-JPEG-003A` covers one bounded CMYK open behavior: a Pillow 11.3.0
  `2x1` CMYK JPEG with four SOF0 `C/M/Y/K` components and Adobe APP14
  transform `0` reopens through native `pillow_c_image_open_jpeg` as mode

- `FMT-JPEG-003B` covers the historical CMYK save unsupported boundary:

- `FMT-JPEG-003D` covers bounded baseline CMYK save at `quality=95` through the

- `FMT-JPEG-003E` covers bounded CMYK `optimize=True` save at `quality=95`:

- `FMT-JPEG-003F` covers bounded baseline CMYK metadata save at `quality=95`:

### TIFF Multipage, Tags, And Modes

Rows: `FMT-TIFF-001`, `FMT-TIFF-001A`, `FMT-TIFF-002`, `FMT-TIFF-003`.

Status: partial.

Current covered baseline:

- WIC-backed `L`, `RGB`, and `RGBA` open/save.
- Basic multiframe open/count/seek.
- Bounded native TIFF `save_all` / `append_images` for homogeneous two-frame
  `L`, `RGB`, and `RGBA` fixtures through `pillow_c_image_save_tiff_frames`;
  the writer emits little-endian uncompressed baseline TIFF IFD chains from
  each frame's native mode.
- One same-size mixed L/RGB pair is covered, including Pillow-compatible L IFD
  omission of SamplesPerPixel and inclusion of PlanarConfiguration `1`.
- One mixed-size RGB `2x1` / `1x2` pair is covered with per-frame IFD geometry
  and facade seek-size refresh.
- One three-frame RGB chain is covered with two nonzero next-IFD links and a
  final zero terminator.
- Two-frame RGB PackBits is covered through a native multiframe compression
  export and facade option routing.
- The same route is covered for LZW and Adobe Deflate, with native Deflate's
  stored-block size difference kept explicit.
- Facade `Image.Save(..., "TIFF", {SaveAll:true, AppendImages:[...]})`
  routes to the DLL without AHK pixel loops.

Unknown behavior to pin down:

- Broader `save_all` matrices across `RGB`/`RGBA`, mixed modes, metadata, and
  option interactions.
- Compression options, tag read/write, palette, bilevel, high-bit, `I`, `F`,

- Which remaining parts can stay WIC-backed and which require native TIFF

- Facade save dispatch and metadata mapping.

### FMT-ICO-001A: ICO Append Images Exact-Size Entries

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 `_save` builds `provided_ims = [base] + append_images`,
  sorts/deduplicates requested `sizes`, skips sizes larger than the base image,
  and uses the first provided image whose size exactly matches the requested
  size.
- The covered fixture saves a `32x32` red RGBA base plus `16x16` green and
  `24x24` blue append images using default ICO sizes. It writes PNG-backed
  entries `[16,16]`, `[24,24]`, and `[32,32]`; each entry decodes to the
  matching source image's first pixel.

Out of scope:

- Non-exact thumbnail selection from the last provided image.
- Duplicate-size BMP entries with different bit depths.
- Caller-selected ICO open size, CUR headers/hotspots, broad mixed-mode
  matrices, and exact compressed PNG byte parity.

Implementation notes:

- New export:
  `pillow_c_image_save_ico_frames_format_options(images, image_count, path,
  sizes, size_count, has_sizes, bitmap_format)`.
- The existing single-image ICO exports now delegate to the same native helper,
  preserving existing default sizes, explicit empty-size behavior, PNG-backed
  output, and lowercase-only `bitmap_format="bmp"` DIB output.
- `ahk/pillow.ahk` parses public `AppendImages` / `append_images` for ICO and
  passes only image handles, sizes, and bitmap-format options to the DLL. It
  does not perform AHK-side pixel loops.

Verification:

- Red raw evidence: `pillow_c image save_ico_frames_format_options uses
  append_images for exact sizes` failed with a nonexistent
  `pillow_c_image_save_ico_frames_format_options` export.
- Red facade evidence: `Pillow Image.Save ICO append_images uses exact source
  sizes` decoded the `16x16` entry from the red base pixel `[255,0,0,255]`
  instead of the green append image pixel `[0,255,0,255]`.
- Green evidence: Release x64 rebuild succeeded with `0 Warning(s), 0
  Error(s)`; targeted raw passed `1/1` in `125ms`; targeted facade passed
  `1/1` in `47ms`; raw ICO regression passed `9/9` in `265ms`; facade ICO
  regression passed `5/5` in `62ms`.
- Source and Release x64 DLL export counts are now `365` / `365`.

Status: covered.

  then square descending using stable ordering.

  `pillow_c_image_open_ico_size` keep their ABI.

  rebuilds the chosen payload as a one-entry ICO, and decodes that through WIC.
  This avoids WIC's own duplicate-size frame ordering choosing the wrong
  payload.

  `image.ico.getimage(...)` through the existing DLL calls without AHK
  per-pixel loops.

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 keeps top-level opened ICO images as `format == "ICO"`
  before and after selected-size `load()`.
- PNG-backed `im.ico.getimage((16,16))` returns an image with
  `format == "PNG"` and `format_description == "Portable network graphics"`.
- PNG-backed `im.ico.getimage((18,18))` missing-size fallback also returns the
  largest embedded PNG payload with `format == "PNG"`.

Out of scope:

- BMP/DIB-backed ICO payload metadata is covered by `FMT-ICO-002E`.
- CUR headers/hotspots and broader embedded-payload metadata.

Implementation notes:

- New export:
  `pillow_c_image_ico_payload_format(path, width, height,
  require_requested_size, out_format, out_size, out_required)`.
- The export parses the ICO directory, applies the same Pillow-compatible
  selected-entry logic used by native ICO open, and currently returns `"PNG"`
  for PNG-backed payloads or an empty string for unrecognized/DIB payloads.
- `ahk/pillow.ahk` routes `image.ico.getimage(...)` through the existing native
  image open calls and then calls this metadata export to set the returned
  facade image's `Format`; no AHK per-pixel loop is used.

Verification:

- Red raw evidence:
  `pillow_c image ico_payload_format reports embedded PNG format` failed with
  nonexistent `pillow_c_image_ico_payload_format`.
- Red facade evidence:
  `Pillow Image.Open ICO getimage exposes embedded PNG format` failed with
  `Expected "PNG", got ""`.
- Green evidence: Release x64 rebuild succeeded with `0 Warning(s), 0
  Error(s)`; targeted raw passed `1/1` in `32ms`; targeted facade passed
  `1/1` in `31ms`; raw ICO regression passed `13/13` in `312ms`; facade ICO
  regression passed `9/9` in `63ms`; full AHK directory passed `1269/1269` in
  `4016ms` with known non-failing libjpeg stderr warnings.
- Source and Release x64 DLL export counts were then `368` / `368`.

### FMT-ICO-002E: ICO DIB Payload Metadata

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 returns `format is None` and `format_description is
  None` for DIB-backed `im.ico.getimage((16,16))` child images.
- Lowercase `bitmap_format="bmp"` DIB-backed children expose
  `info["compression"] == 0` and `info["dpi"] ~= (96.012, 96.012)`.
- Missing-size fallback `im.ico.getimage((18,18))` exposes the same DIB child
  metadata on the selected largest frame.

Out of scope:

- CUR headers/hotspots, nonzero DIB compression families, and broader
  embedded-payload metadata.

Implementation notes:

- New export:
  `pillow_c_image_ico_payload_dib_metadata(path, width, height,
  require_requested_size, out_has_dib, out_has_dpi, out_dpi_x, out_dpi_y,
  out_compression)`.
- The export parses the ICO directory, applies the same Pillow-compatible
  selected-entry logic used by native ICO open, returns `has_dib=0` for
  PNG-backed payloads, and parses BITMAPINFOHEADER compression plus
  pixels-per-meter resolution for selected DIB payloads.
- `ahk/pillow.ahk` routes `image.ico.getimage(...)` through the existing
  native image open calls, keeps DIB-backed child `Format` empty via
  `pillow_c_image_ico_payload_format`, and maps DIB `dpi`/`compression`
  metadata into the returned child `Info`; no AHK per-pixel loop is used.

Verification:

- Red raw evidence:
  `pillow_c image ico_payload_dib_metadata reports dpi and compression` failed
  with nonexistent `pillow_c_image_ico_payload_dib_metadata`.
- Red facade evidence:
  `Pillow Image.Open ICO getimage exposes DIB metadata` failed because
  `Info["compression"]` was absent.
- Green evidence: Release x64 rebuild succeeded with `0 Warning(s), 0
  Error(s)`; targeted raw passed `1/1` in `63ms`; targeted facade passed
  `1/1` in `32ms`; raw ICO regression passed `14/14` in `328ms`; facade ICO
  regression passed `10/10` in `78ms`; full AHK directory passed `1271/1271`
  in `3890ms` with known non-failing libjpeg stderr warnings.
- Source and Release x64 DLL export counts were then `369` / `369`.

### FMT-ICO-002F: DIB-Backed CUR Open Metadata

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 opens the bounded DIB-backed CUR fixture as
  `format == "CUR"` and `format_description == "Windows Cursor"`.
- The opened image is mode `RGBA`, size `16x16`, and preserves the decoded
  first RGBA pixel `[10, 20, 30, 255]`.
- The opened image exposes `info["compression"] == 0` and
  `info["dpi"] ~= (96.012, 96.012)`.
- The bounded local probe did not expose CUR hotspot values through
  `Image.info`.

Out of scope:

- CUR save, hotspot exposure if a future Pillow oracle proves a public route,
  PNG-backed CUR payloads, multi-entry CUR selection, and nonzero DIB
  compression families.

Implementation notes:

- New exports:
  `pillow_c_image_open_cur(path, out_image)` and
  `pillow_c_image_metadata_dib_compression(image, out_has_compression,
  out_compression)`.
- Native `open_cur` parses the CUR directory, selects the largest entry through
  the existing Pillow-compatible ICO ordering helper for the bounded single
  entry, reads the DIB bit depth from BITMAPINFOHEADER, wraps the selected DIB
  as a one-entry ICO for WIC decode, and attaches DIB DPI/compression metadata
  to the handle.
- The facade recognizes `.cur` / `CUR`, routes open through the DLL, maps
  DIB compression into `Info["compression"]` through `ApplyNativeMetadata()`,
  and explicitly rejects CUR save until a save gap is covered.

Verification:

- Red raw evidence:
  `pillow_c image open_cur reads DIB cursor metadata` failed with nonexistent
  `pillow_c_image_open_cur`.
- Red facade evidence:
  `Pillow Image.Open supports CUR through native path` failed with
  `Pillow image file format is unsupported`.
- Green evidence: Release x64 rebuild succeeded with `0 Warning(s), 0
  Error(s)` after fixing the WIC in-memory stream pointer qualifier; targeted
  raw passed `1/1` in `63ms`; targeted facade passed `1/1` in `31ms`; raw ICO
  regression passed `14/14` in `375ms`; facade ICO regression passed `10/10`
  in `78ms`; full AHK directory passed `1273/1273` in `4016ms` with known
  non-failing libjpeg stderr warnings.
- Source and Release x64 DLL export counts are now `371` / `371`.

### New Format Families

Rows: `FMT-WEBP-001`, `FMT-AVIF-001`, `FMT-LONGTAIL-001`.

Status: not started.

Decision boundary:

- Do not start a new format family until there is a user task or a packaging
  decision for its codec dependency.
- For WebP/AVIF, decide open-only, save-only, still-only, and animation scope
  before writing ABI.
- Long-tail formats should be added one at a time with a real fixture and
  source/oracle notes.

Exit criteria:

- A new format must include a clear dependency strategy, raw tests, facade
  tests, docs, and DLL artifact updates if native code changes.

Current covered baseline:

- Core modes `1`, `L`, `LA`, `P`, `RGB`, and `RGBA` have significant
  operation and file-format coverage.
- Some `I` coverage exists through high-bit-depth PGM.
- `MODE-COLOR-001A` adds native mode ID `13`, three-byte YCbCr raw storage,
  Y/Cb/Cr bands, empty construction, and Pillow-compatible RGB bidirectional
  conversion through DLL-owned lookup-table loops.
- `MODE-COLOR-001B` adds native mode ID `14`, three-byte HSV raw storage,
  H/S/V bands, empty construction, and Pillow-compatible RGB bidirectional
  conversion through DLL-owned float/fmod/floor/round loops.
- `MODE-COLOR-001C` completes direct YCbCr targets with DLL-owned Y-byte
  extraction for `L` and Y-plus-opaque-alpha output for `LA`.
- `MODE-COLOR-001D` adds DLL-owned RGBA/RGBX/CMYK-to-HSV conversion by reusing
  the exact RGB HSV and CMYK-to-RGB helpers.
- `MODE-COLOR-001E` adds a shared DLL-owned `[0,0,V]` conversion loop for
  packed mode `1`, L, and LA inputs.
- `MODE-COLOR-001F` adds DLL-owned explicit RGB/RGBA palette lookup before the
  shared HSV helper, ignoring palette alpha.
- `MODE-COLOR-001G` adds native mode ID `15`, three-byte public LAB storage,
  L/A/B bands, legal empty construction, and A/B high-bit xor exclusively at
  DLL raw import/export boundaries.
- `MODE-COLOR-001H` adds native mode ID `16`, two-byte PA storage, P/A bands,
  legal empty construction, and explicit RGB/RGBA palette ownership through
  the shared bulk native palette ABI.
- `MODE-COLOR-001I` adds DLL-owned P -> PA, PA -> P, and PA -> RGBA loops;
  palette alpha initializes P -> PA pixels, PA -> RGBA uses only per-pixel A,
  and palette metadata survives P/PA conversion including empty images.
- `MODE-COLOR-001J` adds DLL-owned PA -> RGB/L/LA conversion: color and luma
  ignore both alpha sources, while LA pairs fixed-point luma with per-pixel A.
- `MODE-COLOR-001K` adds DLL-owned PA -> CMYK/YCbCr/HSV conversion by reusing
  the existing subtractive, lookup-table, and HSV kernels while ignoring alpha.
- `MODE-COLOR-001L` adds DLL-owned P -> LA/YCbCr conversion, selecting palette
  alpha for LA and reusing the exact YCbCr lookup kernel.
- `MODE-COLOR-001M` adds DLL-owned P/PA -> I/F conversion, writing rounded
  int32 or unrounded float32 palette luma while ignoring both alpha sources.
- `MODE-COLOR-001N` adds DLL-owned P/PA -> mode 1 direct thresholding; palette
  sources ignore dither and alpha while other modes retain error diffusion.
- `MODE-COLOR-001O` confirms existing empty-palette P/PA -> RGB/RGBA behavior,
  and `MODE-COLOR-001P` adds DLL-owned P/PA -> RGBX expansion.
- `MODE-COLOR-001Q` adds DLL-owned RGBX -> RGB/RGBA/L/LA conversion while
  ignoring X and forcing opaque alpha where Pillow does.
- `MODE-COLOR-001R` adds DLL-owned RGBX -> CMYK/YCbCr conversion while
  ignoring X and reusing the existing subtractive and 6-bit lookup kernels.
- `MODE-COLOR-001S` adds DLL-owned RGBX -> I/F conversion while ignoring X and
  reusing the rounded int32 and unrounded float32 RGB luma kernels.
- `MODE-COLOR-001T` adds DLL-owned RGBX -> mode 1 conversion under NONE and
  Floyd/default dither while ignoring X.
- `MODE-COLOR-001U` adds DLL-owned RGB/RGBA -> I/F conversion while ignoring
  RGBA alpha and reusing the shared RGB numeric luma kernel.
- `MODE-COLOR-001V` adds DLL-owned 1/L/LA -> I/F scalar promotion while
  ignoring LA alpha.
- `MODE-COLOR-001W` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> I/F conversion by composing the
  clipped YCbCr-to-RGB lookup kernel with the shared RGB numeric luma kernels.
- `MODE-COLOR-001X` adds DLL-owned CMYK -> I/F conversion inside the existing
  CMYK loop after its rounded black-channel-scaled RGB expansion.
- `MODE-COLOR-001Y` adds DLL-owned HSV -> I/F conversion by composing the
  hue-sector-sensitive HSV-to-RGB helper with the shared numeric luma kernels.
- `MODE-COLOR-001Z` adds DLL-owned HSV -> L/LA conversion by composing the
  same hue-sector-sensitive RGB expansion with rounded fixed-point luma and
  opaque LA alpha.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AA` adds DLL-owned HSV -> mode 1 conversion: NONE applies
  RGB weighted thresholding, while Floyd/default compose HSV expansion inside
  the existing native error-diffusion traversal.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AB` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> mode 1 conversion: NONE applies
  weighted thresholding after clipped RGB expansion, while Floyd/default
  compose that expansion inside native error diffusion instead of using Y.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AC` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> RGBA conversion by composing the
  clipped YCbCr-to-RGB lookup kernel with opaque alpha `255` in one traversal.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AD` adds DLL-owned HSV -> RGBA conversion by composing the
  hue-sector-sensitive HSV-to-RGB helper with opaque alpha `255` in one
  traversal.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AE` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> RGBX conversion by extending the
  clipped YCbCr-to-RGB four-channel loop to append X=`255` for RGBX targets.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AF` adds DLL-owned HSV -> RGBX conversion by extending the
  hue-sector-sensitive HSV-to-RGB four-channel loop to append X=`255`.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AG` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> CMYK conversion by composing the
  clipped YCbCr-to-RGB helper with subtractive C/M/Y and K=`0` in one loop.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AH` adds DLL-owned HSV -> CMYK conversion by composing the
  hue-sector-sensitive HSV-to-RGB helper with subtractive C/M/Y and K=`0` in
  one loop.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AI` adds DLL-owned YCbCr -> HSV conversion by composing the
  clipped YCbCr-to-RGB helper with exact RGB-to-HSV rounding in one traversal.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AJ` adds DLL-owned HSV -> YCbCr conversion by composing the
  hue-sector-sensitive HSV-to-RGB helper with the exact RGB-to-YCbCr lookup
  kernel in one traversal.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AK` adds DLL-owned CMYK -> RGBX conversion by extending the
  black-channel-scaled CMYK-to-RGB four-channel traversal with X=`255`.
- `MODE-COLOR-001AL` adds DLL-owned CMYK -> YCbCr conversion by composing the
  black-channel-scaled CMYK-to-RGB helper with the exact RGB-to-YCbCr lookup
  kernel in one traversal.
- `MODE-I-001A`, `MODE-F-001A`, `MODE-NUM-001B`, `MODE-NUM-001C`,
  `MODE-NUM-001D`, `MODE-NUM-001E`, `MODE-NUM-001F`, `MODE-NUM-001G`, and
  `MODE-NUM-001H`, `MODE-NUM-001I`, `MODE-NUM-001J`, `MODE-NUM-001K`,
  `MODE-NUM-001L`, `MODE-NUM-001M`, `MODE-NUM-001N`, and
  `MODE-NUM-001O`
  cover numeric
  `getextrema()`, `histogram()`, `I`/`F -> L` conversion, bounded mode `I`
  `ImageFilter.Kernel`, mode `F` Kernel wrong-mode rejection, bounded
  `I`/`F` rank-filter semantics, and `I`/`F` `ModeFilter` wrong-mode
  rejection, plus `I`/`F` BoxBlur/GaussianBlur/UnsharpMask wrong-mode
  rejection, plus `I`/`F` non-logical ImageChops binary wrong-mode rejection,
  plus `I`/`F` `Image.blend` wrong-mode rejection, plus `I`/`F`

  parity, plus `I`/`F` `ImageOps.Equalize` / `Autocontrast`

- `MODE-NUM-001O` is backed by raw DLL and facade tests. It reuses the

- `MODE-NUM-001N` is backed by raw DLL and facade tests. It reuses the

  tags `322`/`323`, tile byte range scalar tags `324`/`325`, and JPEGTables
  UNDEFINED tag `347` are
  materialized through
  `Image.GetExif()` / `getexif()` while TIFF `Info["exif"]` remains absent.
- Bounded SHORT array IFD0 tag lifecycle for JPEG/PNG: tag `530`
  (`YCbCrSubSampling`) can be stored together with ASCII, scalar integer, and
  rational tags in `Image.Exif`, serialized through the native short-array
  EXIF route, explicitly saved, and read back from reopened `getexif()` as a
  `[2, 1]` array.
- Bounded BYTE array IFD0 tag lifecycle for JPEG/PNG: tag `40091` (`XPTitle`)
  can be stored together with ASCII, scalar integer, rational, and SHORT array
  tags in `Image.Exif`, serialized through the native byte-array EXIF route,
  explicitly saved, and read back from reopened `getexif()` as a `Buffer`.
- Bounded SRATIONAL IFD0 tag lifecycle for JPEG/PNG: tag `37380`
  (`ExposureBiasValue`) can be stored together with ASCII, scalar integer,
  rational, SHORT array, and BYTE array tags in `Image.Exif`, serialized
  through the native signed-rational EXIF route, explicitly saved, and read
  back from reopened `getexif()` as a `[-1, 2]` array.
- Bounded `META-002A` XMP read lifecycle for PNG/JPEG: PNG `iTXt` key
  `XML:com.adobe.xmp` and JPEG APP1
  `http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/\0` packets are extracted in native open paths,
  exposed as raw `Info["xmp"]` bytes, and parsed by `Image.getxmp()` into the
  locally proven Pillow-style nested map shape.
- Bounded `META-002B` JPEG XMP write lifecycle: local Pillow 11.3.0 writes
  lowercase `xmp=` as APP1 XMP after JFIF/EXIF and before ICC/COM metadata,
  while PNG `xmp=` is a no-op; native save writes the same marker through the
  new JPEG metadata XMP export and reopen exposes it through `Info["xmp"]`.
- Bounded `META-002C` JPEG qtables plus XMP write lifecycle: local Pillow
  11.3.0 accepts explicit `qtables` with lowercase `xmp=`, writes APP1 XMP
  before DQT payloads, and does not implicitly preserve opened XMP for keep
  saves; native save composes caller qtables and explicit XMP through the new
  qtables metadata XMP export and reopen exposes it through `Info["xmp"]`.
- Bounded `META-002D` JPEG keep_rgb plus XMP write lifecycle: local Pillow
  11.3.0 accepts no-qtables `keep_rgb=True` with lowercase `xmp=`, writes
  APP14 Adobe transform `0` and APP1 XMP before DQT payloads, and reopens with
  RGB component markers plus `Info["xmp"]`; native save composes keep-rgb
  metadata and explicit XMP through the new keep-rgb metadata XMP export.
- Bounded `META-002E` JPEG qtables plus keep_rgb plus XMP write lifecycle:
  local Pillow 11.3.0 accepts caller qtables, `keep_rgb=True`, and lowercase
  `xmp=`, writes APP14 Adobe transform `0`, APP1 XMP before DQT payloads, and
  RGB component markers with caller qtables; native save composes caller
  qtables, keep-rgb output, and explicit XMP through the new qtables keep-rgb
  metadata XMP export.
- Bounded `META-002F` XMP repeated RDF sequence parsing: local Pillow 11.3.0
  materializes repeated `rdf:li` children as a list under `Image.getxmp()`,
  while the native PNG XMP bytes remain exposed through the existing
  `pillow_c_image_metadata_xmp` route.

Unknown behavior to pin down:

- Full EXIF object behavior beyond orientation tag `274`, bounded common
  ASCII IFD0 tags `270`/`271`/`272`/`305`/`306`, bounded scalar integer IFD0 tags
  `256`/`257`/`296`/`531`, bounded rational IFD0 tags `282`/`283`, bounded
  TIFF position rational tags `286`/`287`, bounded TIFF scalar tags `254` and
  `266`, bounded SHORT array tag `530`, bounded BYTE array tag `40091`,
  bounded SRATIONAL tag `37380`, bounded UNDEFINED tag `36864`, bounded
  UserComment tag `37510`, and reopened TIFF common ASCII/DPI/extended
  ASCII/scalar/array/UNDEFINED IFD0 readback through JPEGTables tag `347`;
  broader TIFF tag lifecycle, nested IFDs, MakerNote
  preservation, implicit image-save mutation writeback, broader XMP schemas
  beyond the repeated RDF sequence child now covered by `META-002F`, implicit
  XMP preservation, PNG
  `PngInfo` XMP write convenience, IPTC, broader ICC profile lifecycle beyond
  bounded TIFF open metadata, `ImageCms`, and
  metadata preservation across broader save paths.

- Facade `info`, bounded `GetExif`, and save option mapping.

Exit criteria:

- Metadata work is format-scoped unless a stable shared metadata ABI is being

Rows: `PERF-001`, `PERF-002`, `ABI-001`, `TEST-001`, `TEST-002`, `PKG-001`.

Status: partial or not started.

Current covered baseline:

- Many hot paths already call into native code.

- README and docs are split so README does not carry all iteration history.

Unknown behavior to pin down:

- Benchmark budgets for representative image sizes and workloads.
- SIMD/threaded kernels behind stable ABI.
- Public C header, ABI versioning, and generalized options ABI.
- Oracle fixture generation, decoder rejection tests, memory stress tests, CI,
  release verification, and compatibility matrix.

Start in code/tests:

- New benchmark harness outside normal `ahktest` correctness tests.
- `docs/native-abi.md`, eventual public header, and release docs.
- `oracle/pillow_oracle.py` or equivalent fixture tooling.

Exit criteria:

- Performance claims require repeatable benchmark output.
- ABI changes require docs and compatibility notes in the same patch.
- Packaging work should make a release easier to consume without moving
  volatile iteration notes back into README.

## Source-Probe Rules

Some Pillow behaviors are too specific to infer from black-box tests alone.
Source inspection is appropriate when:

- Pillow behavior depends on plugin option precedence.
- A native algorithm must match integer rounding, clipping, or palette choice.
- The observed fixture result is ambiguous across modes.
- The feature touches metadata preservation or animation state.

Preferred order:

1. Create a tiny Python fixture with `F:\Python\Python310\python.exe`.
2. Inspect installed Pillow source for the exact local version when present.
3. If local source is insufficient, inspect Pillow 11.3.0 upstream source.
4. Encode the discovered rule in AHK tests before implementing.

When documenting source-derived behavior, name the Pillow module or function
that was checked so future work can verify drift after Pillow upgrades.

## Facade API Gaps

Rough comparison against `PIL.Image.Image` public methods shows the current
facade has analogues for most common methods:

- Present or roughly present: `alpha_composite`, `apply_transparency`, `blend`,
  `close`, `composite`, `convert`, `copy`, `crop`, `draft`, `effect_spread`,
  `entropy`, `eval`, `filter`, `frombytes`, `getbands`, `getbbox`,
  `getchannel`, `getcolors`, `getdata`, `getexif`, `getxmp`, `getextrema`,
  `getpalette`, `getpixel`, `getprojection`, `histogram`, `load`, `merge`,
  `paste`, `point`, `putalpha`, `putdata`, `putpalette`, `putpixel`,
  `quantize`, `reduce`, `remap_palette`, `resize`, `rotate`, `save`, `seek`,
  `split`, `tell`, `thumbnail`, `tobitmap`, `tobytes`, `transform`,
  `transpose`, `verify`.
- Covered property child: `API-IMG-001A` adds `format_description` through
  `FormatDescription` and `format_description`.
- Covered property child: `API-IMG-001B` adds `has_transparency_data` through
  `HasTransparencyData` and `has_transparency_data`.
- Covered method child: `API-IMG-001C` adds `get_child_images()` through
  `GetChildImages()` and `get_child_images()` for the currently implemented
  empty-list boundary.
- Missing or not currently meaningful in this AHK/native design:
  full Python-core `readonly` semantics beyond the bounded buffer-view
  signal. `getim`/`im`/`show`/`toqimage`/`toqpixmap` are now covered
  through `API-IMG-001D`/`API-IMG-001E`/`API-IMG-001F` (native-handle
  analogue and explicit documented boundaries).
  `Format` exists as an AHK-style
  property but is not full Python object-model parity.

### API-IMG-001A: Image Format Description Property

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 reports `Image.new(...).format_description is None`.
- Opened native formats report stable descriptions, including
  `Portable network graphics` for PNG, `JPEG (ISO 10918)` for JPEG, and
  `Compuserve GIF` for GIF.
- The AHK facade exposes `Image.FormatDescription` and
  `Image.format_description`, using `""` as the existing AHK-side analogue for
  Python `None` when `Image.Format == ""`.

Verification:

- Red targeted facade:
  `Expected Pillow.Image FormatDescription properties: This value of type
  "Pillow.Image" has no property named "FormatDescription".`
- Green targeted facade:
  `Ran 1 tests in 31ms; Passed: 1, Failed: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`.
- No native code changed and no DLL export was added.

### API-IMG-001B: Image Has Transparency Data Property

Status: covered.

Scope:

- Local Pillow 11.3.0 reports `Image.new("RGB", ...).has_transparency_data`
  as `False`.
- Local Pillow 11.3.0 reports alpha modes `RGBA` and `LA` as `True`, even when
  all pixels are opaque.
- Local Pillow 11.3.0 reports non-alpha modes `P`, `RGB`, and `L` as `True`
  when `Image.info["transparency"]` is present.
- The AHK facade exposes `Image.HasTransparencyData` and
  `Image.has_transparency_data`, using the current native mode and the existing
  `Info` map. This adds no AHK per-pixel loop and no native ABI symbol.

  `Ran 1201 tests in 3532ms; Passed: 1201, Failed: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0`,
  with the known non-failing libjpeg stderr warnings.
- No native code changed and no DLL export was added.

## Metadata And Color Management Gaps

This is one of the largest remaining parity areas.

Covered:

- Basic `info` map propagation for many derived images.
- PNG DPI.
- JPEG DPI/JFIF fields.
- Bounded TIFF save/open DPI Resolution tags.
- XBM hotspot.
- GIF duration/loop/background/disposal/transparency.
- Basic EXIF orientation read path for transpose behavior.
- Bounded `Image.Exif` / `getexif()` lifecycle for orientation tag `274`,
  common ASCII IFD0 tags `271`, `272`, `305`, and `306`, and scalar integer
  IFD0 tags `256`, `257`, `296`, and `531`, plus rational IFD0 tags `282`
  and `283`, plus SHORT array tag `530`, plus BYTE array tag `40091`, with native EXIF byte
  serialization/parsing and explicit JPEG/PNG save routing.
- Bounded XMP lifecycle for PNG/JPEG open metadata, explicit JPEG `xmp=`,
  explicit JPEG `qtables + xmp`, explicit JPEG no-qtables `keep_rgb + xmp`,
  explicit JPEG `qtables + keep_rgb + xmp`, repeated RDF sequence parsing
  through `META-002A` through `META-002F`, and bounded TIFF XMP open metadata
  through `META-002M`, `META-002N`, `META-002O`, and `META-002P`; duplicate
  standard JPEG XMP APP1 precedence is covered by `META-002Q`.
- Bounded TIFF ICC profile open metadata through `META-002G`, `META-002H`,
  `META-002I`, `META-002J`, `META-002K`, and `META-002L`: reopened RGB,
  `I;16`, `I`, and `F` TIFF `ICCProfile` tag `34675` bytes, selected RGB,
  `I;16`, `I`, and `F` TIFF frame ICC bytes after `seek(1)`, and the bounded
  RGB TIFF BYTE type `1` ICC tag shape are exposed as `Info["icc_profile"]`
  and through `Image.GetExif()` / `getexif()` tag `34675`, while TIFF
  `Info["exif"]` remains absent.

Remaining:

- Full EXIF object behavior beyond the covered orientation, common ASCII IFD0
  tag, scalar integer IFD0 tag, rational IFD0 tag, SHORT array tag, and BYTE
  array tag children.
- Broader XMP schemas beyond the repeated RDF sequence and TIFF tag `700`
  children, selected `I;16B` TIFF XMP metadata, implicit XMP preservation, and
  PNG `PngInfo` XMP write convenience beyond
  `META-002A` / `META-002B` / `META-002C` / `META-002D` / `META-002E` /
  `META-002F` / `META-002M` / `META-002N` / `META-002O` / `META-002P` /
  `META-002Q`.
- Broader ICC profile lifecycle beyond bounded TIFF open metadata.
- IPTC and other plugin metadata.
- Color management via `ImageCms`.
- Metadata preservation on save across formats.
- General plugin-specific `info` dictionaries.

## Performance And ABI Gaps

Strong direction already in place:

- Coarse native calls for hot operations.
- Handle-owned contiguous storage.
- `_into` allocation-reuse variants for many operations.
- Direct data pointer sharing with explicit lifetime rules.

Still missing:

- Benchmark suite with fixed image sizes and budgets.
- SIMD or threaded kernels.
- Streaming/tiled decode/encode for large images.
- Stable public C header and versioned ABI documentation.
- A more general native options ABI for format saves, instead of adding a new
  export for every option cluster.
- Memory-leak and lifetime stress tests.

## Recommended Priority Queue

These priorities are ordered from the direct Pillow `11.3.0` difference
assessment in `docs\pillow-direct-diff-assessment.md`, not from raw missing
symbol counts.

2. Stabilize existing hot formats without branch explosion.
   Continue GIF only for a concrete palette-stability or pathological
   animation boundary proven by local Pillow. For PNG, extend the generalized
   metadata route and batch same-route cases; do not add more
   one-combination branches.

3. Continue JPEG only for a new proven keep/metadata/codec boundary.
   The opened comment-preserved and ICC/EXIF-not-implicit rule is covered; do
   not reopen it unless a broader marker-preservation or explicit-precedence
   oracle goes red.

4. TIFF tags/compression after bounded multipage save.
   `FMT-TIFF-001A-AW` cover homogeneous/mixed frames, metadata, complete DPI
   lifecycle for `I;16` plus numeric `I`/`F`, and compressed 16-bit endian
   normalization plus bounded compressed/uncompressed full metadata and
   uncompressed DPI-only/DPI+ICC/DPI+XMP/DPI+ASCII/DPI+ICC+XMP plus the full
   ICC+ASCII and XMP+ASCII families plus full-binary Description; continue
   The bounded uncompressed metadata family through AX is covered; continue
   only through a new explicit TIFF gap after the selected META work.
   Keep tag, compression, high-bit, and broader mode behavior as separate
   children. Do not combine them into one broad TIFF patch.

5. Dependency-gated format expansion.
   WebP still image open/save is the first likely high-value new format if a
   dependency/package decision is made. AVIF, JPEG2000, PDF, PCX, DDS, ICNS,
   CUR, and other formats each need explicit gap IDs and fixtures.

6. Full quantize algorithms.
   Required for serious palette/GIF parity, but keep algorithm parity separate
   from small GIF animation descriptor fixes.

7. FreeType, Unicode text, and RAQM/Harfbuzz shaping.
   Treat this as a dedicated dependency and ABI milestone, not a small
   ImageDraw patch.

8. `ImageCms` and full ICC transform/color-management lifecycle.
   Current ICC work is byte preservation inside specific formats; Pillow-level
   profile transforms are a separate major surface.

9. Performance benchmark harness.
   Add repeatable native-vs-AHK and native-vs-Pillow measurements after the
   correctness slice for the selected hot path is stable.

10. Packaging and stdlib-level API polish.
   Add clearer examples, release process, public ABI header, compatibility
   matrix, and documented unsupported surfaces.

## Update Rule

Whenever a feature moves from "remaining" to "covered":

1. Add or update AHK tests first.
2. Implement native/facade behavior.
3. Rebuild `build\x64\Release\pillow_c.dll` if native code changed.
4. Run targeted tests, then the full AHK directory suite from the parent
   `visual_studio` directory with `-TimeoutSeconds 240`.
5. Update this document and `docs/native-abi.md` in the same change.
